narrative:
Material PL1__M9B1EC3D exhibits moderate demand patterns with CV=0.55 and variable lead times (CV=1.23).
The analysis reveals significant optimization potential. Current SAP policy uses conservative safety stock (113 units) 
with frequent small orders (MOQ=227), resulting in excessive ordering costs ($30,087/year).

The optimized EOQ-based policy recommends:
- Increased safety stock to 687 units (accommodating higher demand variability and service level target of 95.0%)
- Larger order quantities of 4185 units (constrained by storage capacity of 4872 units)
- Reorder point at 979 units
- Review period of 8 days

This optimization reduces total annual costs by $27,608 (91.5%), primarily by reducing ordering 
frequency from ~602 to ~33 orders per year. The dominant 
uncertainty driver is lead time variability (74%), suggesting focused risk mitigation efforts.
